Item 1.01

Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement 

The information provided in Item 3.02 of this Current Report is incorporated herein by reference into this Item 1.01. 

Item 3.02

Unregistered Sale of Equity Securities 

On November 25, 2026, FirstEnergy Corp. (“FirstEnergy” or the “Company”) contributed 6,334,459 shares of its common stock, $0.10 par value (the “Shares”), to the FirstEnergy System Master Retirement Trust (the “Trust”) to satisfy certain future funding obligations of FirstEnergy and its subsidiaries to the Trust. The Shares were contributed in a private placement, exempt from the registration requirements under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Act”) pursuant to Rule 506(c) promulgated under the Act, in accordance with the terms of the contribution agreement, dated
 November 25, 2026 (the “Contribution Agreement”), between FirstEnergy and State Street Global Advisors Trust Company (“State Street”), in State Street’s capacity as independent fiduciary and investment manager of a segregated account in, and on behalf of, the Trust. The Shares were valued at $299,999,978.24 in the aggregate by State Street, on behalf of the Trust, at the time of the contribution. 

In connection with the Contribution Agreement, FirstEnergy also entered into a registration rights agreement, dated November 25, 2026 (the “Registration Rights Agreement”), with State Street, in its capacity as independent fiduciary and investment manager of a segregated account in, and on behalf of, the Trust, pursuant to which FirstEnergy agreed to provide certain registration rights with respect to the Shares and file a registration statement on Form 
S-3
 under the Act (the “Registration Statement”) for the purpose of registering the resale, from time to time, of the Shares by the Trust. The Registration Rights Agreement includes customary exceptions permitting FirstEnergy to suspend the use of the Registration Statement from time to time. 

The foregoing summaries of the Contribution Agreement and the Registration Rights Agreement are qualified in their entirety by reference to the text of the Contribution Agreement and the Registration Rights Agreement, which are filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 4.1 hereto, respectively, and are incorporated herein by reference. 

In addition, separate from its role as independent fiduciary and investment manager of a segregated account in the Trust, State Street also serves as an independent fiduciary and investment manager for shares of FirstEnergy’s common stock in the FirstEnergy Corp. Savings Plan. State Street Corporation, an affiliate of State Street, together with certain of its affiliates, beneficially owns 41,234,821 shares of our common stock, representing approximately 7.2% of the outstanding shares of our common stock as of the filing of State Street Corporation’s most recent Schedule 13G with the Securities and Exchange Commission on January 30, 2024.
